title: Efficient AI Development in Business Central: Caveman Mode Explained
summary: Caveman Mode is a communication technique that reduces AI token consumption by approximately 75% while maintaining technical accuracy. This approach instructs AI to provide minimal narrative, drop pleasantries, and use brief responses, making it practical for cost-conscious Business Central development.
key_points: Caveman Mode cuts token usage by around 75% by eliminating narrative filler and pleasantries from AI responses
Three intensity levels exist: lite (short sentences with grammar), full (fragments and dropped articles), and ultra (abbreviations and symbols)
The mode persists once activated and can be toggled with commands like /caveman lite or normal mode
Security warnings and irreversible action confirmations are auto-exceptions that revert to normal clarity

quotes.text: Caveman Mode. In this case we instruct the AI to answer in as short a response as possible, except when urgent.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core principle of the technique for reducing AI-generated content and token consumption

quotes.text: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts tokens ~75% while keeping technical accuracy.
